about_the_game:
OVERVIEW

Do you enjoy cat cafés? In the world of Pawfee Bean, experience work life as a cat while running your own evening café!

FEATURES

All Paws on Deck!

Be your own boss, or sit back and relax while you let your friends do all the work! Create your own lobby, and choose between a solo-play or online co-op experience!

Meow Hiring!

Need a helping paw? Create a personalized café code, invite fellow cats to your café, and put them to work!

Craft the Purrfect Catmosphere!

Unleash your inner decorator! Rearrange your furniture and decorations to cook up an efficient workplace or a homely atmosphere! The choice is yours… as long as customers can’t get in the way! ;3

A Knead to Purrpare!

Freshly baked goods every day! Play minigames to bake goods and prepare your café before opening up for the evening!

Cater to Every Whisker and Whim!

Hospitality is a key component to running a cozy café! During open hours, run around, take customers’ orders, and give ‘em what they want! Thankfully, they all seem to have incredible patience…

Let Your Cat Out of the Bag!

Stand out from the rest of the cats in town! As you work, discover different ways to stylize your cat to your own personal liking! Unlock unique cosmetics as you gain more experience working in cafés!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel I5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® Iris® Xe Graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Do you love cats? How about coffee? Pawfee Bean lets you experience the laid-back work life of a cat running their very own evening café! Tailor your dream café either alone or with up to 4 players! The purrfect pastime to spend with fellow felines and a warm cup of Pawfee!
